description: Source code for the class 'ColumnBasedSet' which implements the 'RowSet' interface, handling serialization/deserialization of row data, managing columns, and converting to Thrift row set objects within Apache Hive's Thrift server component.

classes.name: ColumnBasedSet
classes.description: Implements RowSet, manages column data, serialization/deserialization, and conversion to Thrift row set.

methods.name: addRow
methods.description: Adds a row of data to the set, either as a blob or as individual column values.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Returns the list of column buffers.

methods.name: extractSubset
methods.description: Extracts a subset of rows up to maxRows.

methods.name: toTRowSet
methods.description: Converts the internal data to a Thrift TRowSet object.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over the rows as Object arrays.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Fills an Object array with data from a specific row index.
